Browse current openings across our branches. New positions are posted daily, and you can sign up below to be notified when roles matching your interests become available in your area.

Example Staffing has connected people with work since 1984, across light industrial, skilled trades, transportation, professional, and administrative placements. We staff contract, contract-to-hire, and direct-hire positions, and our recruiters work with hiring managers directly rather than through an automated queue, so the person you speak with is the person advocating for your application.

Applying takes a few minutes. Create a profile once and it carries across every branch, so you do not re-enter your history for each role you are interested in. A recruiter reviews new applications within two business days and will reach out by phone or email to confirm your availability, shift preferences, and any certifications the role requires.

Benefits vary by assignment and are outlined during the interview. Many contract roles include medical, dental, and vision coverage after a qualifying period, weekly pay, and access to safety training at no cost. Talk to your recruiter about what applies to the specific position you are considering, since these differ between branches and between client sites.
